messages:
Diego Ramos: Heads-up: we're moving runner registration from long-lived tokens to OIDC-issued ephemeral tokens. Goal: reduce leaked token blast radius and enable auto-rotation. Migration window: Mon Aug 3 01:00-03:00 UTC. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/migrations/runner-ephemeral-2026. Please flag any runners that need persistent identities.

Harpreet Kaur: Quick Q: will existing runners be able to re-register automatically or do we need an agent update?

Diego Ramos: Agent update required (v2.4.0). It adds OIDC flow and auto-refresh. We'll keep a compatibility shim for 7 days where both token and OIDC registration work. Please upgrade runner fleets before the window.

ci-bot: preflight checks: runner-image-compat -> PASS, oidc-endpoint-health -> PASS, token-usage-detect -> WARNING (124 runners still using legacy tokens). See /debug/ephemeral-1835007777.

Liam O'Connor: Ops note: autoscaling pools will briefly deregister during token rotation. Expect ~60-90s of runner churn per pool. We'll stagger upgrades to keep at least one healthy runner per pool.

DevEx: We'll ship a migration helper: `redwood runner migrate --org $ORG --pool $POOL --dry-run` that performs a simulated registration and prints required env changes. Also publishing sample systemd unit to start the new agent.

Harpreet Kaur: What about CI service accounts used for deploys? They currently push tags using token auth.

Diego Ramos: Deploys will switch to short-lived git tokens minted via the same OIDC exchange. We'll publish an example flow in the runbook. Token TTL default 1h; we can request longer TTL for approved deploy pipelines.

ci-bot: migration job scheduled: migrations/runner-ephemeral-1835007777. Smoke tests: runner-register -> PASS (on v2.4.0), pipeline-trigger -> PASS.

Liam O'Connor: We'll post the stagger schedule in the sheet and tag owners. If >2% of jobs fail across a pool for 10m we pause and revert to token acceptance for that pool. Rollback steps are in the runbook.

Diego Ramos: Thanks team. Please upgrade runners, test `redwood runner migrate --dry-run`, and RSVP to the cutover sync Thu 09:00 PT if you own pools. If you find blockers, drop them here. :shipit:
